_doc: THE BADGE COINS ON THE WALK, derived by tools/badge_coins.ts from commons/data/badges/coins.json, commons/void/rooms.json, commons/data/artifact_timeline_walk.json, commons/modular/grammar.json, commons/data/stickers/readings.json and designs.json; never edit (edit coins.json, then run ../ada_encyclopedia/node_modules/.bin/tsx tools/badge_coins.ts). n is the order along the walk through the tower: floor_index ascending (the tower is walked downward), then the walk's own n on the floor; the coins that replace works on a floor are ONE group, met in coins.json order (Trans_Pre: pick, translate, rotate, scale), at the earliest walk n of their works that are walk stops, or before the floor's other coins when none is; ties in coins.json order; label is n with two digits at least. A coin that replaces a work stands where it stood: position, height and facing are that work's raw rooms.json values (the work is then not stood). A coin at a stop hovers over the stop's stand ([x, z]) at the stop's y. gives: the verb the coin hands the player when it is collected (verbs). face and back: the two sides as SVG (100 x 100, no die-cut; the rim's outer edge on the inscribed circle, so the SVG lies straight on the coin's cap), lettering as paths (ThorVG draws no <text>); line: the words on the back.

basic.title: Basic grammar
basic.note: the acts that turn one form into the next: commons/modular/grammar.json, an operation of one form (genesis, distance, extension, hand, transform ...)

complex.title: Complex grammar
complex.note: acts that combine acts: rule, recursion, rewriting, relation, decision, assemblage (grammar.json)

paradox.title: Paradoxes
paradox.note: two things a hall's text holds true at once (commons/data/stickers/readings.json, kind paradox)

edge.title: Edges
edge.note: where the research says, in its own words, that it stops (readings.json, kind edge)

pick.title: Pick
pick.does: lift a thing you placed and set it down somewhere else

translate.title: Translate
translate.does: move a thing you placed a little: push it away or pull it nearer
translate.vr: while lifting it, push the right stick forward or back

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.does: turn what you place, and a thing you lift

scale.title: Scale
scale.does: make a thing you placed bigger or smaller
scale.vr: while lifting it, push the right stick left or right
